metadata.description: Generated from corrected Chapter 8 production/preflight script.

chapter_8_production_canon.midori_age: Age 11 pre-timeskip; age 13 post-timeskip beginning Page 32.
chapter_8_production_canon.woa: Passive observation field; no portal/UI/mechanical-screen behavior.
chapter_8_production_canon.door_2: Voluntary choice only; Zorna may encourage but cannot compel.
chapter_8_production_canon.zorna_lie: Zorna knows magical power does not provide a direct route back to Earth.
chapter_8_production_canon.truk_reincarnation: Zorna does not choose Truk's next life or circumstances.
chapter_8_production_canon.saburo_shove: Accidental death caused by habitual bullying; no intent to kill.
chapter_8_production_canon.slave_ship_pages_53_54: Render from approved script/directorial instructions; no external PDF or dedicated asset required.

1-3-1 — Panel 1 wide establishing panel; Panels 2–4 three-column middle sequence; Panel 5 wide closing panel. Give Panel 1 and Panel 5 the greatest visual weight.
Visual continuity: Terra, Zorna, and Nyssara retain the same canonical DOTG costumes, hair, apparent ages, and relative station positions throughout Act 0. The observation field geometry and cool blue-violet illumination remain consistent page to page.

Do not render observed Japan/Earth imagery in 70/30.

Visual continuity: Use post-timeskip Midori at age 13 from this point forward. Other recurring children must also reflect the same elapsed time; do not revert to their earlier child proportions or pre-timeskip sheets.
Visual continuity: Truk’s face, build, official clothing, and status markers remain consistent through the Aokawa visit and his death. The later slave-ship captain deliberately resembles Truk’s former face but uses period-appropriate late-1600s hair and clothing.
Visual continuity: Once Midori and Aiko put on the ceremonial shrine garments, they remain in those garments through the procession, Midori’s death, and the immediate roadside aftermath. Preserve garment damage/soiling caused by the accident.
Visual continuity: Lock the carriage’s direction of travel, horse order, driver position, Midori/Aiko roadside positions, and Saburo’s approach side. Once Midori is shoved, preserve her exact relationship to the horses and carriage through the impact sequence; do not reverse screen direction.
Visual continuity: Saburo leaves in the same clothing he wore at the procession unless the panel explicitly shows time for changing. His bundle appears only once departure preparations have occurred.
